gloss: to defy; to stand up to; to rebel against

definitions.gloss: to defy; to stand up to (someone above one)
definitions.explanation: To oppose or talk back to someone one is expected to obey, such as a parent, teacher or boss. The person defied is marked with に. Seen from the side of the authority, so it often carries disapproval.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たてついて⟦{左遷|させん}→左遷：06831_sasen⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He stood up to his boss and was demoted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たてつく⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられなかった→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, talking back to a teacher was unthinkable.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written {盾突|たてつ}く or {楯突|たてつ}く: to raise one's shield against someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たてつく: to defy one's parents
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たてつく: to stand up to those in power
- ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たてつく: to defy one's superiors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逆|さか}らう→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧: to go against, disobey — broader and neutral, also used of the wind or the current
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}する→反抗する：25385_hankousuru⟧: to rebel — more formal; ⟦{反抗期|はんこうき}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧ is a child's rebellious phase
